name: Rainbow Heartbeats
source:
Welcome to the beautiful gated community of Arblevale!

There are over a dozen places to visit here in Arblevale, and over 16 bachelors/bachelorettes to chose from, if you're into that kind of thing! I even heard rumors of beautiful sirens luring people into Perchance Lake, and huge wolves roaming the streets on full moons.

[From [url=https://opalizardstudios.itch.io/rainbowheartbeats]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到美丽的封闭式社区阿布尔谷！

这里有十多处地方可供游览，如果你对恋爱感兴趣，还有超过16位单身男女任你结识！我甚至听说，有美丽的塞壬将人诱入偶遇湖，满月时还有巨狼在街头游荡。

[摘自[url=https://opalizardstudios.itch.io/rainbowheartbeats]Itch.io[/url]]
